text:
maria: Heads up — planning to enable zephyr-7b-optimized in the model catalog during the 18:00 UTC change window. Staged rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. Need final fallback ordering, deploybot hold/lift plan, and enterprise pin guidance.

zach: +1. Do we have the latency & QA thresholds documented for each stage?

maria: yes — telemetry doc attached (will paste in release notes). Quick summary: p95 latency <= 150ms, error_rate < 0.5%, model quality eval pass rate >= 98% on core prompt set. If any trigger fires for 5m we'll fallback.

devin: proposing fallback ladder: zephyr-7b-optimized -> zephyr-7b-quant -> harbor-13b-stable. Quant variant should be used before falling to harbor to preserve quality.

sara: enterprise customers must remain pinned to harbor-13b-stable for this cutover. Add pin rule so enterprise routing ignores staged traffic.

maria: noted — will add pinlist entry for enterprise tiers and enterprise tenants.

kai: ops checklist: preflight at 17:30 UTC (healthchecks, kv cache warm, model load mem check). Deploybot should start with HOLD flag; we lift in 3 steps after telemetry green: lift->10% wait 10m->50% wait 10m->100%.

ops-bot: DeployBot: scheduled enable for zephyr-7b-optimized at 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z. Initial state: HOLD. Operators: @maria, @devin.

deploybot: /deploy schedule --model zephyr-7b-optimized --stages 10,50,100 --hold true --start 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z --owner maria

zach: For fallback triggers, confirm thresholds: latency p95 > 150ms for 5m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR eval_fail_rate drop > 2% compared to baseline. If triggered, immediately revert to the next variant in ladder.

devin: agreed. Also add a fallback TTL of 15m for automated fallback before human review — fallback should be automatic but require ops review before permanent pin changes.

sara: Clarify pin behavior: enterprise pins mean the model will never be evicted by staged rollout, correct?

maria: correct — enterprise pins are sticky until explicitly removed. We'll include in release notes and notify CS.

kai: rollback snippet for ops (add to runbook):
```
# rollback to harbor-13b-stable
/deploy revert --model zephyr-7b-optimized --target harbor-13b-stable --reason "latency spike" --force
```

maria: I'll do the preflight and post preflight sanity when we hit 17:30. Tagging @zach for telemetry dashboards and @kai for runbook updates.

zach: I'll verify dashboard thresholds and set alerts: p95_latency, error_rate, eval_pass_rate. Will add rapid-alert channel to #incidents/alerts.

kai: updating runbook now and adding the rollback snippet to the ops playbook. Also adding a small warmup script to preheat KV cache (10k sample requests).

ops-bot: DeployBot: HOLD is active. Use `/deploybot lift-hold 6500000001` to start staged rollout.

maria: plan: 17:30 preflight -> 17:45 final signoff -> 18:00 start (HOLD) -> 18:05 lift to 10% -> watch 10m -> lift to 50% -> watch 10m -> lift to 100%. If any trigger -> auto-fallback to ladder and ops page open.

sara: I'll send the customer advisory to CS before 17:45.

zach: quick note: remember to disable experimental quant fallback for EU region (compat issue). We'll pin EU to the non-quant ladder entry for this rollout.

maria: good catch. I'll add regional exceptions: EU -> skip zephyr-7b-quant and fallback directly to harbor-13b-stable.

devin: final ask — add canary traffic split logs to the telemetry export so we can correlate latency bump with request types.

maria: done. Any objections?

zach: no objections from me. :thumbsup:

sara: same. :thumbsup:

kai: all set on my side.

maria: ok lock. I'll post the short release notes and invoke deploybot at 17:58 to transition to HOLD. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
